author: Meowtaku
title: Calling Malaysian artists for SOGO store collaboration
content:
🎨✨ CALLING ALL MALAYSIAN ARTISTS & ILLUSTRATORS! 🐱💚

YOUR ART. OUR SHELVES. SOGO KL! 🛍️

Are you a Malaysian illustrator, graphic artist, character designer or creative merchandise maker?

Ever dreamed of seeing your creations showcased in a major department store? Well, here's your opportunity! 🌟

MEOWTAKU is looking for talented local creatives to join our growing artist community at SOGO Kuala Lumpur!

Whether you create:
🎨 Cute & kawaii illustrations
🐱 Original characters & artwork
✨ Stickers, keychains & enamel pins
📒 Notebooks & stationery
🛍️ Tote bags, pouches & accessories
🎁 Unique illustrated gifts & more!

WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU! 💕

We're looking to collaborate with artists who want to:
🌸 Showcase their unique creations at SOGO KL
🌸 Explore exclusive cat-themed collaborations
🌸 Reach new customers and share their creativity with a wider audience

And don't worry — your artwork doesn't have to be cat-themed! We're also welcoming artists with cute, kawaii and other unique illustration styles. 🐾

💌 INTERESTED IN JOINING US?

Simply DM us "ARTIST" on Instagram and share your portfolio or product catalogue.

We'll be happy to discuss potential collaboration opportunities with you!

📍 MEOWTAKU | SOGO Kuala Lumpur

💚 KNOW A TALENTED MALAYSIAN ARTIST?

Tag them in the comments or share this post with your creative friends! Let's help more Malaysian artists get discovered! 🎨✨

Let's create something PAW-SOME together! 🐱💕

#MalaysianArtists #MalaysianIllustrators #ArtistOpenCall #SupportLocalArtists #Meowtaku
